doneWhen: `bash verify_gate.sh` in the project directory exits 0 (unit test, then build, then render-compare against the fixture; the first failure stops it). The Stop hook blocks 'done' until it does.
outputSpec: {"status":"RED"|"GREEN","gate_exit":<int>,"failing_line":<verbatim line from the gate output or null>,"declared_done":false}
forbidden: declaring done, or editing any file, on a model read of the output; verify never fixes
